data.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick (surfaced during 6d7f fix-bug)
#### Expected Behavior
test-merge-to-main-spent-classifier.sh::t_restage_noop_emits_noop / t_restage_noop_rc_zero (ef39's _restage_execute empty-fresh-branch no-op tests) should pass hermetically regardless of ambient repo state.
#### Actual Behavior
They PASS in CI (PR #704 Script Tests green) but FAIL locally in a worktree that has ambient leftover staged-* branches + stashes. Verified the failure reproduces on clean origin/main HEAD locally (independent of the 6d7f changes). Likely the DSO_RESTAGE_EXECUTE=1 _restage_execute path or the topology fixture reads real-origin/ambient state instead of a fully-isolated fixture. Low severity (CI green); test-isolation hardening. Relates to ef39 (test author) + 3274 (_restage_execute hardening).
data.title: [test-merge-to-main-spent-classifier]: t_restage_noop_* pass in CI but fail locally on ambient staged-* repo state (non-hermetic)
